mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO exception_case AS existing ( exception_key, exception_type, reason_code, severity, status, validation_run_id, contract_id, agent_id, policy_version_id, source_entity_type, source_entity_id, cap_check_id, title, description ) VALUES ( #{exceptionKey}, #{exceptionType},
CASE WHEN #{exceptionType} = 'CAP_VIOLATION' THEN 'CAP_LIMIT_VIOLATION' WHEN #{exceptionType} = 'CAP_WARNING' THEN 'CAP_LIMIT_WARNING' ELSE #{exceptionType} END, #{severity}, 'NEW', #{validationRunId}, #{contractId}, #{agentId}, #{policyVersionId},
'COMMISSION_TRANSACTION', CAST(#{paymentId} AS varchar),
#{capCheckId}, #{title}, #{description} ) ON CONFLICT (exception_key) DO UPDATE SET exception_type = EXCLUDED.exception_type, reason_code = EXCLUDED.reason_code, severity = EXCLUDED.severity, validation_run_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.validation_run_id, existing.validation_run_id), contract_id = EXCLUDED.contract_id, agent_id = EXCLUDED.agent_id,
cap_check_id = EXCLUDED.cap_check_id, title = EXCLUDED.title, description = EXCLUDED.description, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE existing.status IN ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW')
mapper.select: SELECT exception_case_id, status FROM exception_case WHERE exception_case_id = #{exceptionCaseId} AND exception_type IN ('CAP_WARNING', 'CAP_VIOLATION') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exception_action ( exception_case_id, action_seq, from_status, to_status, action_type, reason, evidence_ref, action_by ) SELECT #{exceptionCaseId}, COALESCE(MAX(action_seq), 0) + 1, ec.status, 'RESOLVED', #{actionType}, #{reason}, #{evidenceRef}, #{actionBy} FROM exception_case ec LEFT JOIN exception_action ea ON ea.exception_case_id = ec.exception_case_id WHERE ec.exception_case_id = #{exceptionCaseId} GROUP BY ec.status
mapper.update: UPDATE exception_case SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE exception_case_id = #{exceptionCaseId} AND status IN ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exception_case WHERE source_entity_type = 'COMMISSION_TRANSACTION' AND source_entity_id = CAST(#{paymentId} AS varchar) AND exception_type = 'CAP_VIOLATION' AND status IN ('NEW', 'IN_REVIEW') )
